goal: Decide whether hash-256 stays the documented default, and prepare the 0.0.3 benchmark table

items.text: Re-run braindb eval with openai/text-embedding-3-small and with the vector-only control, same gold set, same k
Cost of the experiment: 144 node texts and 32 queries embedded once, then cached by sha256(model + text), so repeat runs are free
If the remote model lifts paraphrase MRR above 0.5, does graph mode still beat vector mode, or was the graph compensating for a weak seed?
Fully offline alternative for the same run: Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434/v1 with nomic-embed-text, so the experiment is not actually blocked on a paid key
Draft for the 0.0.3 README: keep hash-256 as the default for offline and zero-cost use, and state at the quick start that paraphrase recall needs a real model
Rule for this workspace: no number enters the README without engine, dimension, node count, k and date next to it
Add an agent-shaped bucket to the gold set, taken from real transcripts: questions asked mid-task, with the id that ended the search
